legend: Singly dispersed pleomorphic cells with abundant often eccentric cytoplasm and pleomorphic nuclei, large nucleoli, and occasional nuclear pseudoinclusions. No pigment is identified. (Giemsa)
Singly dispersed malignant cells with large nucleoli and occasional prominent nucleoli. Occasional binucleate forms are seen and no pigment is identified (Pap).

Large cohesive crowded tissue fragment of cells with pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei with no definite gland formation or intracytoplasmic vacuoles and some dispersed similar cells in the background. Occasional binucleated cell. No melanin pigment is present. (Giemsa)

Cohesive tissue fragment consisting of a thin capillary with elongated nuclei, and large atypical cells with variable (often moderate to low) N:C ratios; ovoid to pleomorphic enlarged nuclei; and pale, occasionally granular cytoplasm. (Pap)
Tissue fragment of atypical cells with abundant vacuolated or pale cytoplasm, large variably pleomorphic nuclei, and several prominent nucleoli. (Giemsa)
Sheets of large cells with microvacuolated cytoplasm and moderately pleomorphic nuclei. (Cell block, H&E)
